name: user_id
description: Which person this day belongs to

name: moderate_intensity_min
description: Garmin intensity minutes at moderate effort (sustained elevated HR, workout logged or not)

name: vigorous_intensity_min
description: Garmin intensity minutes at vigorous effort (counts double in weekly goals)

name: deep_sleep_latency_min
description: Minutes from sleep onset to the first deep-sleep stage (from Garmin's sleepLevels timeline). NULL for un-staged nights and rows synced before 2026-08-27 that haven't been re-synced.

name: hrv_avg
description: HRV status avg (populates after several nights of wear)

name: weight_lbs
description: Body weight in pounds, from Garmin body composition (smart scale or manual log)

name: medications
description: Medications taken this day (manually logged; not from Garmin). Preserved across daily re-syncs.

name: raw
description: Full per-metric Garmin payloads for this day (lossless, future-proof)
